sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A witch of unknown origin enveloped in mystery. After some time Yunie came to be known as a master of her craft, which only brought more unwanted visitors to her door. It was due to these unpleasant guests that she moved to the ruins at the heart of the Empire versus the Federation conflict. The ruins were full of magical booby traps powered by the Demon Fragment that lay deep within them, helping her create a new workshop that automatically cast away intruders all on its own. However, her happy life of research and leisure in the ruins came to an abrupt halt as things between the Empire and the Federation took a turn for the worst.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Lazy Witch Yunie |bf2 = true }} '''Yunie''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== A witch of unknown origin enveloped in mystery. After some time Yunie came to be known as a master of her craft, which only brought more unwanted visitors to her door. It was due to these unpleasant guests that she moved to the ruins at the heart of the Empire versus the Federation conflict. The ruins were full of magical booby traps powered by the Demon Fragment that lay deep within them, helping her create a new workshop that automatically cast away intruders all on its own. However, her happy life of research and leisure in the ruins came to an abrupt halt as things between the Empire and the Federation took a turn for the worst. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Yunie |element = Dark |image1 = Navi chara bf2 167 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 167 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 167 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 167 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 167 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 167 5.png |image6note = Hurt }} ==Trivia==
